Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [I was offered a 10% discount on first…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/69d283d29fa282570d6e6d17)

I was offered a 10% discount on first order. I accepted this offer, placed an order for three items and was given a 10% discount on the cheapest item only. Seems like classic bait and switch.

I won't patronize this business as a result.

There is no customer service option that I could see on the website.

I subsequently saw an overwhelming number of negative customer reviews on different sites, confirming my decision not to do business with this company.

April 4, 2026

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 6, 2026

Thank you for your feedback—we’re sorry to hear about your experience and any frustration this may have caused.

Our promotions are subject to specific terms and conditions, and in some cases, discounts may apply only to eligible items within an order rather than the entire purchase. We understand how this could have been unclear and appreciate you bringing it to our attention.

We do have a dedicated Customer Experience team available to assist with any questions or concerns, and we’d be happy to review your order in more detail.

We truly value your feedback and hope to have the opportunity to assist you further.
